title: NOT blackout curtains
text: NOT blackout curtains. These are very pretty and easy to hang. However, I wanted what was advertised... BLACKOUT curtains. These are absolutely not blackout or even room darkening curtains. They are thin and just a single layer of fabric so the sunlight shines on in. As regular curtains, these are fine.
